children: Oil prices extend gains, with front-month Brent crude futures rising back above $105 a barrel. According to an AFP report citing Iran's news agency Fars, an adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei warns that Tehran might expand the Middle East war to the Indian Ocean if the U.S. or Israel attacks again. In midmorning European trading, the global oil benchmark gains 2.3% to $105.47 a barrel, while the U.S. oil gauge WTI is up 1.8% to $93.80 a barrel. (giulia.petroni@wsj.com)
